label: NMM Gold
description: Non-metallic metal reads as 'metal' through extreme, sharp value contrast rather than metallic paint. Gold is one of the most forgiving NMM ladders to start with because its whole range sits in the warm yellow-ochre family.
notes: Keep the transitions between steps sharp rather than smoothly blended, especially between Midtone and Bright. Metal reads through abrupt value jumps, not soft gradients.
The Specular Reflection is a tiny, hard-edged dot or line of pure white, placed opposite the object's main light source reflection, not blended into the highlight at all.
Reuse the Deep Shadow and Shadow steps for any recesses (folds, engravings) even far from the main light, since metal shows dark reflections of its dark surroundings, not just local shading.
